sources.entry: Inkscape - Inkscape is a Free and open source vector graphics editor.

summary.name: Inkscape
summary.one_liner: Inkscape is a free and open source vector graphics editor, hosted here on its GitLab project repository.
use_cases: Browsing Inkscape source code and branches
Finding Inkscape release tags such as 1.4.x
Free alternative to commercial vector design software
summary.what_it_does: The page is the GitLab repository for the Inkscape project, showing its source code browser. It lists 19 branches (including master, 1.4.x and 1.3.x) and 20 tags, with release tags such as INKSCAPE_1_4_4 and INKSCAPE_1_4_3. The visible content is mostly repository navigation and a code owners section with no table entries shown. The listing describes Inkscape as a free and open source vector graphics editor.
notable: Hosts the official Inkscape source code repository on GitLab
Maintains versioned release branches such as 1.4.x and 1.3.x
Release tags go back to INKSCAPE_1_3_ALPHA
caveats: Page is a code repository view, not a product landing page; platform support for the app itself is not stated on this page
